subject: display error with geom_bar and very fine lines

messages.author: 91481440fd4fef18
messages.subject: display error with geom_bar and very fine lines
parts:
Dear ggplot2 users,

I just wanted to notice here that using a bar plot with very fine
lines (happened to me in a histogram) sometimes does not display all
the data unless one uses, e.g., geom_histogram(colour="black") to make
the border have a colour.

That's all,
Moritz
